title: Summit Choice Benefit Entitlements
content:
Choice benefits are selections a Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member earns for a qualification year at the upper tiers. This chart gives, for each tier, how many selections are earned and what one selection of each option gives.

| Tier | Selections earned per qualification year | Upgrade certificates given by one selection of upgrade certificates | Bonus miles given by one selection of bonus miles | Companion certificate available as a selection | One-year Summit Club Individual membership available as a selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Member | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Summit Silver | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Summit Gold | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Summit Platinum | 1 | 4 | 20000 | Yes | No |
| Summit Diamond | 2 | 6 | 25000 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Chairman | 3 | 8 | 30000 | Yes | Yes |

**Notes**

- Summit Member, Summit Silver and Summit Gold earn no selections, so the per-selection columns carry no entitlement for them.
- The club membership option opens at Summit Diamond; the companion certificate option at Summit Platinum.
- Hypothetical reading: a Summit Diamond member has 2 selections for the qualification year; one selection of upgrade certificates gives 6 certificates and one selection of bonus miles gives 25000 miles.
